definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese soup made with dashi broth, lightly seasoned with soy sauce and salt. Unlike miso soup, it has a clear, transparent broth. Typically served in a lacquered bowl as part of a formal or semi-formal Japanese meal.

examples.japanese: お{吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三|み}つ{葉|ば}→三つ葉：11242_mitsuba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}えた→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: I garnished the clear soup with mitsuba.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have clear soup and grilled fish for dinner tonight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|だ}された→出す：01087_dasu⟧お{吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧で⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: The clear soup served at the traditional restaurant had such an elegant dashi aroma that it moved me.

notes:
USAGE:
お{吸|す}い{物|もの} is the polite form of ⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧. The お prefix is almost always used in everyday speech. It is a standard part of Japanese washoku cuisine and commonly served at formal meals, celebrations, and traditional restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (make clear soup)
- ⟦{松茸|まつたけ}→松茸：13119_matsutake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{吸|す}い{物|もの} (matsutake mushroom clear soup)
- ⟦はまぐり→ハマグリ：23183_hamaguri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{吸|す}い{物|もの} (clam clear soup — traditional at Hinamatsuri)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ is miso soup, which uses fermented soybean paste and is opaque. お{吸|す}い{物|もの} uses a clear dashi broth and is considered more refined. ⟦{汁物|しるもの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧ is a general term for any soup served as part of a Japanese meal.
